basic_info.description: Welcome to 415-417 44th Avenue, a beautifully refreshed multi-unit home in San Francisco's desirable Richmond neighborhood just blocks from Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, and Lands End. Fully vacant, this versatile property offers two spacious units plus a ground-floor bonus room, ideal for multigenerational living, passive rental income, or remote work. The first-floor unit features refinished hardwood floors, fresh paint, new light fixtures, and a cozy fireplace. The kitchen includes new vinyl flooring and refreshed cabinets, while the bathroom offers new faucets. New carpet adds warmth to the bedrooms. Upstairs, the second unit mirrors these updates with fresh paint, new carpet and fixtures, a fireplace, and stylish bathroom improvements including new toilets. The kitchen also features vinyl flooring, updated cabinets, and stainless steel appliances. A ground-level bonus room adds flexibility, perfect for an office, gym, or guest suite. Fresh exterior & interior paint, and new fixtures enhance curb appeal. Located in a quiet part of Richmond district with easy access to transit, schools, cafes, and outdoor landmarks, 415-417 44th Avenue is a rare, move-in-ready opportunity in one of San Francisco's most scenic neighborhoods.
